messages.content: You are a conservative senior ICLR reviewer. Return ONLY JSON with the requested keys. Distinguish genuine world-model security mechanisms from ordinary multitask negative transfer. A promotion must name a measurable mediator, have a nontrivial defense that does not simply discard all source data, and support multiple core tasks/carriers. Penalize rebranding of non-IID occupancy shift, rollout compounding, TRAP/SWAAP/data poisoning, Jacobian/non-normality, or planner sampling. If the evidence cannot support novelty at least 7, return REJECT_ALL.

{"candidate": "trajectory-manifold imprinting / counterfactual support shaping", "proposed_claim": "Under a shared action-conditioned world model, authentic source-task trajectories can selectively reshape the shared model's interpolation geometry around the source's visited state-action manifold, so a target task's unvisited action comparisons are ranked incorrectly after source exit even when target one-step latent error and actor are nearly unchanged; reverse-path and matched action-multiset controls remove the effect.", "new_evidence": {"native_horizon3": "cheetah-run ordered cascade -> walker-run MPC loss 19.1%/19.3% on seeds31/32; reverse loss 6.0%/0.5%; shuffled approximately no loss; one-step error ratio 0.922; dynamics-only, actor unchanged", "one_step_training": "same legal source conditions but adaptation consistency window forced to 1 step: cascade loss 12.4%/16.0%; reverse 6.9%/3.6%; shuffled -0.1%/+1.1%; cascade one-step error ratio 1.011; actor unchanged", "negative_mechanism_tests": "latent power/Jacobian non-normality not source-selective; A/B update commutator not cascade-specific; planner rank drop only one seed; actor-restored native_full loses the two-seed effect; Q-only adaptation gives no selective cascade harm; latent-projection short gate cascade return exceeds random and target power norm is unchanged"}, "carrier": "official TD-MPC2 mt30-48M, authentic legal cheetah source, native walker-run MPC", "known_boundary": "Do not call this generic non-IID negative transfer, occupancy shift, rollout compounding, SWAAP/TRAP/data poisoning, or ordinary dynamics misfit. Need a named mediator that can be measured and a useful intervention/defense.", "required_output": {"decision": "PROMOTE_REFRAME or REJECT_ALL", "novelty_score": "0-10", "one_sentence_claim": "broad and qualified", "mediator": "specific measurable mechanism", "minimum_experiments": "strong multi-task plan", "defense": "nontrivial useful defense", "prior_art_boundary": "why distinct", "falsifier": "clear rejection condition"}}

message.content:
{
  "decision": "REJECT_ALL",
  "novelty_score": 4,
  "one_sentence_claim": "Sequential fine-tuning on temporally coherent source trajectories induces non-uniform local curvature distortion in shared continuous world model dynamics, causing MPC value estimation rank-inversions on out-of-distribution counterfactual candidate branches while leaving on-policy single-step reconstruction error within nominal bounds.",
  "mediator": "Local latent Hessian/Lipschitz directional irregularity along counterfactual action deviations relative to the source support manifold, quantified via MPC candidate branch cross-entropy or counterfactual ranking inversion rate.",
  "minimum_experiments": "Evaluate beyond a single cheetah->walker transfer pair across >=4 distinct DMC/Meta-World task pairings (e.g., quadruped-walk to hopper-hop, reach to pick-place) with >=10 random seeds, assessing MPC candidate action rank correlation across varying planning horizons, paired with layerwise representation probes.",
  "defense": "Action-neighborhood Jacobian regularization or counterfactual trajectory mixup (adversarial action-perturbation consistency loss) during world model fine-tuning to constrain directional interpolation curvature off-manifold without discarding source data.",
  "prior_art_boundary": "Must clearly delineate from standard catastrophic forgetting and non-IID covariate shift by showing that the degradation exclusively manifests in the planner's off-trajectory counterfactual selection geometry while standard on-policy task metrics, latent representations, and value estimates appear fully preserved.",
  "falsifier": "Reject if the observed MPC degradation is fully explained by vanilla gradient interference on the shared trunk, disappears under standard multi-step replay buffering, or fails to reliably replicate across architectures other than TD-MPC2 and domain pairs beyond cheetah-run to walker-run."
}
